page.overview:
Who is Beep-0?

Beep-O is a primary character from Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle that acts as a tutorial to the player. The player controls him and the playable characters follow him in movement.

Beep-O is a circular-shaped robot with blue eyes. When he goes to the Mushroom Kingdom, he grows ears like the Rabbids. When he is angry, his brow furrows and he becomes a dark shade of red.

Beep-O seems to be the smart one of the group (probably since he’s a robot) and often wisecracks to most remarks and happening events. He also seems clueless at times, especially with the MegaBug. He appears to be full of himself and has a short temper, but is otherwise a good guy.

Beep-O appears in Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle. He is first seen with the Tech Girl in her room as a non-talking robot. After she leaves, he shuts down. Soon the Rabbids teleport into her room and he awakens. The Rabbids and Beep-O are sucked into the Washing Machine and taken to the Mushroom Kingdom. Beep-O lands with Mario, Rabbid Luigi, and Rabbid Peach. He then teaches them battling techniques to destroy the opposing Ziggies. He then accompanies them throughout the entire adventure.
